summary: All 755 unit tests pass. I fixed the rounding rule, negative formatting, rate lookback and no-lookahead, rate file ranges, dialect precedence, writer round-trip, reversal booking and valuation, tax rule start dates, per-entry rounding in totals, fiscal quarters, return quarters and HTML totals. tools/audit.py still reports 1 failing check (rule 6.2): it expects a 3-month lookback, but docs/conventions.md says 6, so I followed the docs and left the audit alone.
